newsitem.title: BARBADOS: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, PUT WEST INDIES IN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, PUT WEST INDIES IN.

text.p: BRIDGETOWN, Barbados (March 27) Reuter - India won the toss and sent West Indies to bat on the opening day of the third test at the Kensington Oval on Thursday.
A hamstring injury ruled captain Courtney Walsh out of the game and vice-captain Brian Lara was elevated to lead the West Indies for the first time in test cricket.
West Indies - Brian Lara (captain), Sherwin Campbell, Stuart Williams, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Courtney Browne, Franklyn Rose, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Mervyn Dillon.

India - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Anil Kumble, (vice-captain), Navjot Sidhu, Vangipurappu Laxman, Saurav Ganguly, Mohammad Azharuddin, Rahul Dravid, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruvilla, Nayan Mongia, Robin Singh.
